dialogue.content: 今日はよろしくお願いします。お時間になったら始めさせて頂きます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming today. We'll get started at our scheduled time.

dialogue.content: はい、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。今日はお越し頂きありがとうございます。初めに差し支えなければあなたの年齢と性別を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in today. First, if you're comfortable, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: はい、26歳女性です
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm a 26-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: 教えて頂きありがとうございます。今日はどんなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. What brings you in today?

dialogue.content: あの、、、わたし今アルバイトなんですけど
dialogue.English: Well... I'm working a part-time job right now...

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 実は一度も就職したことがなくて
dialogue.English: The thing is, I've never had a full-time job.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: アルバイトもあまり続かなくて将来が不安なんです
dialogue.English: I also can't seem to hold a part-time job for very long, and I'm anxious about my future.

dialogue.content: ええ、そんなふうに感じてらっしゃるのですね、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, I understand you're feeling that way.

dialogue.content: このままじゃいけないと思っているんですけど、なんかどうしたらいいのかわからなくて
dialogue.English: I know I can't go on like this, but I just don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: 今日もバイトを休んでしまいました
dialogue.English: I even ended up taking the day off from my part-time job today.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、不安なお気持ちになりますよね
dialogue.English: I see. That must make you feel quite anxious.

dialogue.content: とても不安です
dialogue.English: I'm very anxious.

dialogue.content: いつからアルバイトをされているのですか？
dialogue.English: How long have you been at your current part-time job?

dialogue.content: 今のところは半年くらい前です
dialogue.English: At my current one, about six months.

dialogue.content: 元々は高校を卒業してから、、、
dialogue.English: Originally, it's been since I graduated from high school...

dialogue.content: そうなのですね今のアルバイトを半年続けていらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So you’ve been at your current part-time job for six months?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、では高校卒業してから8年間ほどアルバイトをしてらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So that means you've been working part-time for about eight years since you graduated high school.

dialogue.content: そうですね24歳の時にこのままじゃだめだと思って、アルバイトしながら美容系の学校に通ったんですけど
dialogue.English: That's right. When I was 24, I felt like I couldn't go on like this, so I went to a beauty school while working part-time, but...

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: なんかあまりちゃんとした学校じゃなかったみたいで、生徒も２０人くらいしかいなくて卒業？できませんでした
dialogue.English: It seems it wasn't a very proper school; there were only about 20 students, and I couldn't really 'graduate'.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、ちゃんとした学校ではなかったというのはどんなところがなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. What was it that made you feel it wasn't a proper school?

dialogue.content: スタッフというかマネージャーが1人しかないなくてメイン講師も数ヶ月前に卒業した人らしくて、たまにフリーのヘアメイクさんが2〜３人いる程度で
dialogue.English: There was only one staff member, who was more like a manager, and the main instructor was someone who had apparently graduated just a few months earlier. Occasionally, there were only two or three freelance hair and makeup artists.

dialogue.content: ええ、はい、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, I see.

dialogue.content: 今思うと、契約する前に気づかなかった自分が無知で恥ずかしいんですけど
dialogue.English: Looking back on it now, I'm embarrassed by how naive I was for not realizing it before I signed the contract.

dialogue.content: そうでしょうか？そんなことはないと思いますよ、
dialogue.English: Do you really think so? I don't think that's the case at all.

dialogue.content: そうですか？学校がヘアメイク事務所もやってるから、卒業すれば仕事はまわせるとか言われて、、やってるうちに、なんかおかしいなと思って
dialogue.English: Really? They told me that since the school also ran a hair and makeup agency, they could get me work after I graduated... but while I was there, I started to feel like something was off.

dialogue.content: 学校に入る前にしっかり説明をしてくれなかったことが原因でもあるのではないかと思いました
dialogue.English: It sounds to me like part of the problem was that they didn't explain things properly to you before you enrolled.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そうですね、、ちょっと詐欺に近いのかなとも思うんですけど、なんかほんと、安易に決めてしまった自分が悔しくて
dialogue.English: Yes... I feel like it was something close to a scam, but I'm just really upset with myself for making the decision so lightly.

dialogue.content: そんなお気持ちになるのも無理ないですよね、、
dialogue.English: It's only natural that you would feel that way.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お金やお時間を使って勇気を出して挑戦したことだったのにとても悔しい思いをされましたよね。
dialogue.English: You put in money, time, and courage to take on that challenge, so it's completely understandable that you feel so frustrated.

dialogue.content: はい、本当に、、、
dialogue.English: Yes, really...

dialogue.content: お気持ちお察しします。そんな出来事が2年前くらいにあって、少し前に進むのが怖くなってしまったりしますか？
dialogue.English: I can imagine how you feel. Since that happened about two years ago, have you found yourself feeling a little afraid to move forward?

dialogue.content: でも、美容は好きだから何か関わる仕事がしたいと思って今ウエディングサロンで見習いのアルバイトをしてるのですが
dialogue.English: But I do love the beauty industry, so I wanted to find work related to it. I'm currently working part-time as an apprentice at a wedding salon, but...

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 何か、嫌になってきてしまって、、、
dialogue.English: Somehow, I'm starting to grow tired of it...

dialogue.content: そんな気持ちになるのですね、
dialogue.English: So that's how you're starting to feel.

dialogue.content: 例えばどんなところが嫌だなと感じますか？
dialogue.English: For example, what is it about the job that you're starting to dislike?

dialogue.content: 和装がメインのせいか働いてる人は40歳以上の女の人が多くて、基本の仕事は着物の手入れとはばかりであまり美容に関係もしていなくてあとなんかこのままでいいのかなとか、
dialogue.English: Perhaps because it's focused on Japanese formal wear, most of the employees are women over 40. The work is mostly just kimono maintenance, which doesn't have much to do with beauty, and it makes me wonder if I should just stay like this...

dialogue.content: よくわからないけどやる気が出なくて、このままアルバイトでやってけるのかなとか楽しいこともなくて
dialogue.English: I'm not sure why, but I've lost my motivation. I wonder if I can really get by just working part-time like this, and there's nothing I enjoy about it anymore.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、自分のやりたいことができないとモヤモヤしてしまいますね、
dialogue.English: I see. It's frustrating when you can't do what you truly want to do.

dialogue.content: やる気が出ないというのも自然なことではないかと思いました
dialogue.English: I think it's only natural to lose motivation in a situation like that.

dialogue.content: なんかもう全然やる気がでないんです
dialogue.English: I just have no motivation at all anymore.

dialogue.content: 明日も行けるかわからなくて、、、
dialogue.English: I don't even know if I can make it in tomorrow...

dialogue.content: でも行かないと、生活もあるし
dialogue.English: But if I don’t go, I have to make a living...

dialogue.content: そんなお気持ちになるのですね、
dialogue.English: I understand that's how you feel.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 生活のことを考えるととても不安ですよね
dialogue.English: Thinking about how to make a living must make you feel very anxious.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お話しを聞いてあなたは今までこのままの自分じゃいけない、と思って常に挑戦してきましたよね
dialogue.English: Listening to your story, it sounds like you've always been challenging yourself, thinking that you can't stay the way you are.

dialogue.content: はい、、、そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes... I guess that's true.

dialogue.content: ええ、簡単にできることではないかと思いましたよよく頑張ってこられましたよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, and I don't think that's an easy thing to do. You've been working so hard.

dialogue.content: このままの自分じゃいけない、と思うのはどんなことからそう思うのか聞いてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: May I ask what makes you feel that you can't stay as you are?

dialogue.content: 全然頑張れてないですアルバイト、１年くらいでやめちゃうし
dialogue.English: I haven't been trying hard at all. I end up quitting my part-time jobs after only a year or so.

dialogue.content: 生活が安定していないし就職してないとフリーターって言われるし
dialogue.English: My finances aren't stable, and since I don't have a full-time job, people just call me a 'freeter.'

dialogue.content: そうでしょうか？1年続けられたという見方もありますし、生活するために稼がなきゃいけないと不安を抱えながらも自分の好きなことに前向きに挑戦されていることが素晴らしいと私は少なくとも思いました。
dialogue.English: Do you really think so? You could also see it as being able to stick with something for a whole year. And I, for one, think it's wonderful that you're proactively pursuing what you love, even while dealing with the anxiety of needing to make a living.

dialogue.content: そんなふうに周りから言われることでどんなお気持ちになりますか？
dialogue.English: How does it make you feel when people say things like that about you?

dialogue.content: 恥ずかしいです。もう26歳なのに就職したことがないなんて、言えないです。今後就職なんてできないんじゃないかと不安です。
dialogue.English: I'm embarrassed. I can't tell people that I'm already 26 and have never had a full-time job. I'm anxious that I might never be able to get one in the future.

dialogue.content: そのように感じてらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: I understand you're feeling that way.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたとしてはどんなふうになれたらいいなと思いますか？
dialogue.English: Ideally, what would you like your situation to be?

dialogue.content: 本当はプロのヘアメイクさんになりたかったけど、誰かのアシスタントになると収入がないらしいので無理かなと思ってます
dialogue.English: I really wanted to become a professional hair and makeup artist, but I've heard that you don't really earn an income when you're an assistant, so I feel like it's impossible for me.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: だから美容に関わる仕事で就職できたらいいなと思うんですけど、こんな経歴では無理かなと思って
dialogue.English: So I thought it would be nice to get a full-time job in the beauty industry, but with my work history, I think it's probably impossible.

dialogue.content: プロになるまでにはアシスタントをして経験を積まなければならないのですね。
dialogue.English: So to become a professional, you first have to gain experience as an assistant.

dialogue.content: ええ、そのように思われるのですね
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, I understand that's how you feel.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 美容に関わる仕事というのは例えばどんなお仕事ができたらいいなと思われますか？
dialogue.English: When you say a job related to beauty, what kind of work would you ideally like to do?

dialogue.content: ヘアメイクを目指してたのでやっぱりメイクができるといいんですけど、、、容姿に自信がない人に、少しメイクの基本とか知るだけでもっと綺麗になれる、っていうことを教えてあげたいんです
dialogue.English: Since I was aiming to be a hair and makeup artist, I'd really like to do makeup... I want to teach people who aren't confident in their appearance that they can become even more beautiful just by learning the basics of makeup.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、既にあなたの中にやりたいことがあるのですね、とても素敵ですよね、
dialogue.English: I see. So you already have a clear idea of what you want to do. That's really wonderful.

dialogue.content: でも、そもそも求人もあまりなくて
dialogue.English: But, to begin with, there aren't many job openings for that.

dialogue.content: 今のところも、若い人少ないのもあって、すごく良くしてもらっていて、辞めるとも言いづらいんです
dialogue.English: And at my current job, they're very good to me, partly because there aren't many young people, so it's difficult for me to say I want to quit.

dialogue.content: ヘアメイクに携わることができる求人は少ないのですね
dialogue.English: So there aren't many job openings in hair and makeup.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。よくしてもらっている方に辞めることを言うのは勇気がいりますよね
dialogue.English: I see. It takes a lot of courage to tell people you want to quit when they've been treating you so well.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まだ半年だし
dialogue.English: And it's only been six months.

dialogue.content: 次が決まっているわけでもないのでやめられないけど
dialogue.English: And it's not like I have another job lined up, so I can't quit, but...

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: でも、毎日なんか気が重くて今日も休んじゃったし、明日行ける気もしません
dialogue.English: But every day just feels so heavy. I skipped work again today, and I don't feel like I can go in tomorrow either.

dialogue.content: そんなふうに感じられるのですね、
dialogue.English: I understand that's how you're feeling.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 明日どうしたらいいかわかりません
dialogue.English: I don’t know what to do about tomorrow.

dialogue.content: アルバイトに無理をしていく必要はないのではないかと思いましたがいかがですか？
dialogue.English: I was thinking that maybe you don't need to force yourself to go to your part-time job. What do you think about that?

dialogue.content: でも生活があります学校のお金も自分で払って貯金もありません
dialogue.English: But I have living expenses to cover. I paid for that school myself, so I have no savings.

dialogue.content: 来月の家賃も不安です
dialogue.English: I'm worried about next month's rent, too.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、不安になりますよね、
dialogue.English: Of course, that's a very anxious feeling.

dialogue.content: 例えばあなたの状況を知っているご家族などはいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: For example, is there anyone in your family who knows about your situation?

dialogue.content: 一緒には住んでいないですけどいます
dialogue.English: Yes, but I don't live with them.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 自分の家賃や生活費も払っていながら学校のお金も払っているということでとても自立されていらっしゃると思いました、
dialogue.English: The fact that you were paying for school on top of your own rent and living expenses shows that you are very independent.

dialogue.content: お金のことについてもし生活ができないような状況になってしまいそうだったらご家族に相談してみるというのも一つかなと思いましたがいかがですか？
dialogue.English: Regarding your finances, if you get to a point where you feel you can't manage, I was thinking that consulting your family might be one option. How do you feel about that?

dialogue.content: 親には頼れないです、、、いつも怒られていてまたか、みたいな、、、ちゃんと調べて学校を選ばないからだって既に怒られていて
dialogue.English: I can't rely on my parents... They always get angry with me, like, "Here we go again..." They've already gotten angry at me, saying it's because I didn't research the school properly before choosing it.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、そんなふうに言われて悲しい気持ちになりましたよね、
dialogue.English: I see. It must have been very hurtful to be told something like that.

dialogue.content: 悲しいというか、、やっぱり私がだめなんだなと
dialogue.English: It's less that I'm sad, and more that I feel like I'm the one who's no good.

dialogue.content: そんなふうに感じたのですね、先程もいいましたが、自分を責める必要ないのではないかと思いますよ、
dialogue.English: I see that's how it made you feel. As I mentioned earlier, I really don't think you need to blame yourself.

dialogue.content: でも、ちゃんとやれたことがなくて、、、
dialogue.English: But I feel like I've never been able to do anything right...

dialogue.content: これまでにいろんな状況の中で自分の夢のために様々なことに挑戦してきましたよね、学校は思っていたのとは違って結果は出せなかったかもしれないけれど
dialogue.English: You've tried so many different things for your dream under various circumstances. The school might have turned out differently from what you expected, and perhaps you didn't get the result you wanted, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それに挑戦してみようという気持ちが大事なのではないかと思います、挑戦することには失敗や予期せぬ出来事がつきものだったりします
dialogue.English: I think the will to try is what's important. Failure and unexpected events are often part of taking on a challenge.

dialogue.content: 今はまた挑戦しようという気持ちになれません、、、
dialogue.English: Right now, I can't bring myself to try again...

dialogue.content: ええ、いままでよく頑張ってこられましたよね、
dialogue.English: Yes, you've worked so hard up to this point.

dialogue.content: なので明日どうしたらいいか不安です
dialogue.English: That's why I'm anxious about what to do tomorrow.

dialogue.content: いまはあなたにとって優しい時間も必要なのではないかと思いました、
dialogue.English: I think that right now, you might need to be gentle with yourself.

dialogue.content: 優しい時間？
dialogue.English: 'Gentle time'?

dialogue.content: 明日は休んでみてはいかがですか？明日まで休んでみて、またどんなお気持ちになるか考えてみませんか？
dialogue.English: How about taking tomorrow off? You could take the day to rest and then we can think about how you're feeling after that.

dialogue.content: はい、今まで頑張ってこられた分、ゆっくり休んだり考える時間です。
dialogue.English: Yes. It's time for you to rest and think, to compensate for all the hard work you've put in until now.

dialogue.content: そうですね、とても行けそうにはないので、、でも、明日行けなかったら明後日はもっと行けないのではないかと不安です
dialogue.English: You're right, I really don't think I can go... But I'm anxious that if I can't go tomorrow, it will be even harder to go the day after.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、未来を考えれば考えるほど不安になりますよね
dialogue.English: That's right. The more you think about the future, the more anxious you feel.

dialogue.content: はい、怖いです
dialogue.English: Yes, it's frightening.

dialogue.content: 明日休んでみた時にゆっくり自分の時間を作って欲しいと思います
dialogue.English: When you take tomorrow off, I hope you'll take some time for yourself to relax.

dialogue.content: ゆっくりなんて、できるかな、、、
dialogue.English: Relax... I don't know if I can do that...

dialogue.content: 例えばあなたが好きなヘアメイクのことについて調べたり自分がやったりそれともどこかに出掛けて自分の夢のイメージを作るのもいいのかな、と思います
dialogue.English: For example, you could research the kind of hair and makeup that you love, practice on yourself, or perhaps go out somewhere to help you visualize your dream. I think that could be nice.

dialogue.content: はい、、、
dialogue.English: Okay...

dialogue.content: どのように思われますか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel about that?

dialogue.content: 今はそのあとどうしようとばかり思ってゆっくりできるとは思えないですけど、とりあえず明日も休んでみます
dialogue.English: Right now, all I can think about is what I'll do afterward, so I don't think I can relax. But for now, I'll take tomorrow off as well.

dialogue.content: そのようにご自身で思われたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what you've decided for yourself.

dialogue.content: 行けそうにないので、、
dialogue.English: I just don't feel like I can make it in...

dialogue.content: ええ、先程のはあくまでもわたしが提案したことだったので、あなたの決断が聞けてとても嬉しか思います。
dialogue.English: Yes. What I said earlier was just a suggestion, so I'm very glad to hear what you've decided.

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 休むことも簡単にできらことではないかと思いますが、また休んでみて感じたことがあったらお話ししにきてくれますか？
dialogue.English: I know that even just taking a day off isn't an easy thing to do, but after you've rested, would you be willing to come back and talk about how you're feeling?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: はい、ここであなたのとこいつでもお待ちしてますね。こちらこそ大切なお気持ちをお話ししてくださりありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, I will always be here for you. And thank you, as well, for sharing such important feelings with me.

dialogue.content: それでは失礼致します。
dialogue.English: Goodbye for now.

dialogue.content: 失礼します
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: (お疲れ様です。貴重なお時間ありがとうございました。後ほど改善点などコメントでお願いいたします)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your work. I appreciate your valuable time. Please provide feedback on any areas for improvement in the comments later.)

dialogue.content: （お疲れ様でした！勉強になりましたありがとうございました！）
dialogue.English: (Thank you! That was a great learning experience. I appreciate it!)

dialogue.content: 失礼します
dialogue.English: Goodbye.
